categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Modifies node network socket sending behavior and tests handling of TCP chunking in P2P v2 handshakes.
categories.rationale: Addresses test and transport fragility where components assume full messages per socket read, causing intermittent timeouts on segmented TCP streams. As described, TCP segmentation breaks data across reads, causing failures in P2P v2 handshakes and HTTP tests.

categories.name: utils
categories.evidence: Touches networking socket logic and functional tests rather than shared utilities, serialization, crypto, or vendored subtrees.
categories.rationale: The PR addresses network socket chunking and functional test transport handling, which falls outside the utils scope.
